new_libraries.name: Cordial
new_libraries.author: Alexandre Scozzafave Alves
new_libraries.sentence: The Cordial clock: time of day in Cordial hours, minutes, seconds and crons.
new_libraries.paragraph: Converts the time of day to Cordial time (26 hours of 52 minutes of 52 seconds, seven crons to a second, the day starting at noon) with integer arithmetic only, and counts oscillator cycles into crons with an exact remainder, for a clock built on a 32.768 kHz crystal.

library.name: JBHaMqttDiscovery
library.author: Jonny Bergdahl
library.sentence: Home Assistant MQTT device discovery for ESP8266 and ESP32.
library.paragraph: Easily register sensors, switches, binary sensors, buttons, numbers, selects, texts, lights and covers in Home Assistant via MQTT device discovery. Transport-agnostic design supports PubSubClient, espMqttClient and AsyncMqttClient.

library.name: TeensyStep
library.author: luni64
library.sentence: Stepper motor library for PJRC Teensy boards (Teensy 4.0, 4.1, MicroMod, 3.5, 3.6), for drivers with STEP and DIR inputs.
library.paragraph: Version 3 (beta, the interface can still change in details). Step rates up to 300000 steps/s, up to 16 motors or synchronized groups of motors at the same time, changes of target, speed and acceleration during a move. Sketches written for version 2 still compile. Teensy 3.0 to 3.2, LC and STM32 are not supported by version 3; use version 2.3.4 on these boards.
